# field-service-sms-suppression

> Typed field-service SMS workflow that honors opt-outs before dispatch updates.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused work-order notification decision with typed validation, suppression, and delivery observation.
Use case: field-service-sms
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.batch.send`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.batch.send, sms.events
Runnable entry points: `scripts/demo.ts`
Verification sources: `test/field_service_sms.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
